title: Board Tree Redraw Respects Locked Nodes
description: Hierarchical tree redraw (`apply_hierarchical_tree_layout_to_fixture_v1_value` / `RedrawFixtureOptions` hierarchical-tree branch) must respect `lockedNodeIds` like force graph: pinned visible nodes keep their current fixture `x`/`y` on redraw; other nodes still receive Buchheim positions.
summary: Hierarchical tree layout now honors `lockedNodeIds`: before writing Buchheim positions, visible locked graph nodes capture their current fixture centers and those coordinates are written back instead of the computed layout. `HierarchicalTreeLayoutOptions` gained `lockedNodeIds` (serde camelCase). The redraw dispatcher merges top-level `lockedNodeIds` into tree options like force graph. TypeScript `BoardRedrawLayoutOptions.hierarchicalTree` accepts optional `lockedNodeIds`. Added Rust tests `hierarchical_tree_pins_locked_root_coordinates`, `redraw_hierarchical_tree_nested_locked_node_ids_pins`, and Vitest `keeps locked node coordinates fixed on tree redraw`. Verified `cargo test` filters, wasm-pack release build, and full board Vitest.
